50.description: Ocean 50. Lightest brand wash. Aliased by surface/brand-subtle for condition-match banners and selected filter chips.

100.description: Ocean 100. Light brand tint. Unaliased — reserved for hover states on brand-subtle surfaces.

200.description: Ocean 200. Absorbs the retired Sky #9BD6CF. Unaliased — available for illustration and decorative fills.

300.description: Ocean 300. Aliased by text/link-inverse. 9.51:1 on neutral/950 — the only ocean step safe for text on dark surfaces.

400.description: Ocean 400. Mid brand tone. Unaliased — available for illustration and data visualisation.

500.description: Ocean 500. Unaliased — sits between the mid tones and the brand value.

600.description: Ocean 600. THE BRAND VALUE from the style tile. Aliased by border/brand. Fails body text on white (4.44:1) — never use for text under 24px.

700.description: Ocean 700. The text and action step. Aliased by surface/brand, surface/action, text/link, text/brand, border/focus. 6.29:1 on white.

800.description: Ocean 800. Aliased by surface/action-hover and text/link-hover. 9.22:1 with white.

900.description: Ocean 900. Aliased by surface/action-pressed for the active state on primary buttons.

50.description: Earth 50. Lightest warm tint. Unaliased — available as an alternate page wash.

100.description: Earth 100. Aliased by surface/accent-subtle — Badge (Type=accent) and Feature Card label chip backgrounds.

200.description: Earth 200. Unaliased — available for illustration fills and image mattes.

300.description: Earth 300. THE SAND BRAND VALUE from the style tile. Aliased by surface/decorative for illustration and image mattes. Never text (1.61:1 on surface/page).

400.description: Earth 400. Unaliased — illustration and decorative fills only. Fails all text contrast (2.37:1 on white).

500.description: Earth 500. Unaliased. 3.44:1 on white — large text and UI only, never body copy.

600.description: Earth 600. Lightest text-safe warm step. Aliased by border/accent for pull-quote rules and treatment card dividers. 5.41:1 on white.

700.description: Earth 700. THE EARTH BRAND VALUE from the style tile. Aliased by surface/accent and text/accent. 8.83:1 on white.

800.description: Earth 800. Unaliased — reserved for deep editorial surfaces. 12.83:1 with white.

900.description: Earth 900. Deepest warm tone. Source hue for the warm-tinted elevation shadows.

50.description: Flora 50. Lightest botanical tint. Supplement line only — reserved for surface/page or surface/brand-subtle when the Supplement mode is rebuilt. Unaliased in Clinic.

100.description: Flora 100. Supplement line only. Reserved for surface/brand-subtle when the Supplement mode is filled in.

200.description: Flora 200. Light botanical tint. Supplement line only — candidate for surface/selected and hover states in the Supplement theme. Unaliased in Clinic.

300.description: Flora 300. THE FLORA BRAND VALUE from the style tile. RESTRICTED: surface and illustration fills only, never status indicators — it would collide with success green.

400.description: Flora 400. Mid botanical tone. Supplement line only — illustration and packaging-adjacent fills. Fails text contrast on white; never use for copy.

500.description: Flora 500. Supplement line only — candidate for border/brand and non-text indicators in the Supplement theme. Verify against 3:1 before committing.

600.description: Flora 600. Supplement line only. Candidate for surface/action in Supplement mode — verify white contrast before use.

700.description: Flora 700. Supplement line only. Candidate for text/link in Supplement mode. 6.54:1 on flora/50.

800.description: Flora 800. Deep botanical tone. Supplement line only — reserved for dark editorial surfaces in the Supplement theme. Unaliased in Clinic.

900.description: Flora 900. Deepest botanical tone. Supplement line only — reserved for surface/inverse in the Supplement theme if it needs to differ from neutral/950. Unaliased in Clinic.

0.description: Neutral 0. Pure white. Aliased by surface/card, surface/input, surface/elevated, text/on-brand, text/on-accent.

50.description: Neutral 50. Warm off-white. Aliased by surface/page and text/inverse. Chosen over pure white to reduce glare for light-sensitive readers.

100.description: Neutral 100. Aliased by surface/disabled and surface/action-disabled for inactive buttons and unavailable appointment slots.

200.description: Neutral 200. Aliased by border/subtle for list dividers, table row rules, section separators.

300.description: Neutral 300. Aliased by border/default for card outlines and non-interactive container edges.

400.description: Neutral 400. Unaliased — available for decorative rules on dark surfaces.

500.description: Neutral 500. Aliased by text/disabled. 2.54:1 on surface/disabled — an intentional WCAG 1.4.3 exemption for inactive controls.

600.description: Neutral 600. RETUNED from #7D7970 so tertiary text passes AA. Aliased by text/tertiary and border/strong. 4.60:1 on page, 4.81:1 on card.

700.description: Neutral 700. Aliased by text/secondary for card subtitles, treatment duration, metadata, breadcrumbs. 6.57:1 on page.

800.description: Neutral 800. Unaliased — available for a fourth text tier if long treatment pages need one.

900.description: Neutral 900. Aliased by text/primary — the default reading colour for all body copy and headings. 14.78:1 on page.

950.description: Neutral 950. The brand near-black from the style tile. Aliased by surface/inverse for the footer and longevity sections. Also the source of the overlay scrim.

50.description: Success 50. Aliased by surface/success for booking confirmed panels and saved-intake banners.

500.description: Success 500. Aliased by border/success. 3.93:1 on page — clears 3:1 for non-text UI, not for body copy.

700.description: Success 700. Aliased by text/success. 8.01:1 on surface/success.

50.description: Warning 50. Aliased by surface/warning for out-of-state logistics notices and limited-availability strips.

500.description: Warning 500. Aliased by border/warning. 3.66:1 on page — non-text UI only.

700.description: Warning 700. Aliased by text/warning. 7.81:1 on surface/warning.

50.description: Error 50. Aliased by surface/error for validation summaries and failed submission banners.

500.description: Error 500. Aliased by border/error for failed input outlines. 5.03:1 on page.

700.description: Error 700. Aliased by text/error. 8.89:1 on surface/error.

50.description: Info 50. Aliased by surface/info for cash-pay policy notes and what-to-bring callouts.

500.description: Info 500. Aliased by border/info. 4.94:1 on page. True blue, deliberately not Ocean, so system state never reads as brand.

700.description: Info 700. Aliased by text/info. 8.94:1 on surface/info.

display.description: Display typeface. Used by display, heading-1, heading-2, heading-3. Change this one value to swap the entire display typeface.

body.description: Body typeface. Used by body-large, body, label, caption, overline. Change this one value to swap the entire body typeface.

100.description: Space 100 (4px). Fine-adjustment step. Aliased by spacing/micro-gap.

200.description: Space 200 (8px). Aliased by spacing/inline-gap. Also the minimum separation between adjacent touch targets.

300.description: Space 300 (12px). Fine-adjustment step. Aliased by spacing/content-gap and spacing/component-padding on mobile.

400.description: Space 400 (16px). Aliased by spacing/page-margin, card-padding, content-gap, stack-gap, grid-gap on mobile.

500.description: Space 500 (24px). Aliased by spacing/card-padding, card-padding-loose, grid-gap on web.

600.description: Space 600 (32px). Aliased by spacing/page-margin and block-gap on web, card-padding-loose on web.

700.description: Space 700 (48px). Aliased by spacing/section-gap on mobile and spacing/block-gap on web.

800.description: Space 800 (64px). Unaliased — kept in reserve after spacing/section-gap-loose was removed.

900.description: Space 900 (80px). Aliased by spacing/section-gap on web. Matches the platform constraint for desktop section padding.

200.description: Radius 200 (8px). Aliased by radius/medium — the system default.

400.description: Radius 400 (24px). Aliased by radius/xl. Note the jump from 12 — 16px was deliberately removed as an unused escape hatch.

full.description: Radius full (9999px). Aliased by radius/pill for fully rounded shapes.
